0022600147.text: The Utah Jazz (1-4, home record 1-3) are on a three-game losing streak and sit 13th in the West as they host the Portland Trail Blazers (3-0, on a three-game winning streak and 1st in the Northwest) for their sixth game of the season. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Lauri Markkanen is day-to-day with a wrist injury and is a game-time decision, and Portland is without Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet this season, but Utah lost all four games against Portland in 2025-26, most recently 124-114 in Portland on March 13, 2026.
